source_note: 分部求和的想法，Dirichlet-Abel收敛判别法的推广
english_source_note: Summation by Parts and Extensions of Dirichlet-Abel Tests
callout_id: 分部求和的想法,Dirichlet-Abel收敛判别法的推广#2
statement_en:
Assume that \(\sum_{j=1}^{n} a_j = o\left(\sqrt{n}\right)\). Prove that
\[
\sum_j \frac{a_j}{j}
\]
converges.
callout_body:
假设$\sum_{j = 1}^{n} a_j = o\left(\sqrt{n}\right)$,证明：
$$\sum_{j} \frac{a_j}{j}$$ 收敛
